name: -6AN Flare Blockoff Plug
title: -6AN Flare Blockoff Plug
description:
The -6AN Flare Blockoff Plug is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN Flare Block Off Plugs are precision CNC-machined to securely seal unused AN ports in fuel, oil, coolant, brake, and power steering systems. Designed with a true 37-degree AN flare seat, these plugs provide a tight, leak-free seal for high-pressure and high-temperature applications.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
